description: This file handles account resolution for the Synology Chat integration in the openclaw project. It reads configuration from channel settings and environment variables, merges overrides, and provides functions to list and resolve accounts.

methods.name: getChannelConfig
methods.description: Extracts the channel configuration for 'synology-chat' from the full OpenClaw config.

methods.name: resolveImplicitAccountId
methods.description: Determines the implicit account ID based on token presence.

methods.name: getRawAccountConfig
methods.description: Retrieves raw account configuration for a given account ID.

methods.name: hasExplicitWebhookPath
methods.description: Checks if a raw account has an explicitly set webhook path.

methods.name: resolveWebhookPathSource
methods.description: Determines the source of the webhook path (explicit, inherited, default).

methods.name: parseAllowedUserIds
methods.description: Parses allowed user IDs from string or array to string array.

methods.name: parseRateLimitPerMinute
methods.description: Parses rate limit value from string to number, defaults to 30.

methods.name: listAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured account IDs for the Synology Chat channel.

methods.name: resolveAccount
methods.description: Resolves a specific account by ID, applying defaults and environment variable fallbacks.
